ranked_facts.concept_key: histopathological finding of swollen endothelial cells with intracytoplasmic eosinophilic hyaline globules
ranked_facts.why: The presence of swollen endothelial cells with intracytoplasmic eosinophilic hyaline globules is more characteristic of papillary hemangioma than pyogenic granuloma, as the latter typically presents with a different set of histopathological features.

ranked_facts.concept_key: immunohistochemical staining pattern of tumor vessels
ranked_facts.why: The immunohistochemical staining pattern of tumor vessels, including positivity for CD-31 and negativity for D2-40 and HHV-8, is more consistent with papillary hemangioma than with malignant vascular tumors like angiosarcoma.
